overview_description: List the base system events defined on your instance, or retrieve one by its id.
intro: System events are the base events the platform defines, such as the events workflows and custom events build on. You can list them and retrieve one. This area has 2 endpoints, and all seven Exsited SDKs call every one.
notes: **System events are read only.** They are the base events the platform defines; there are no writes in this area.
**System event ids start with `evt_`.** A custom event's `base_event` takes an `se_` id instead, so a listed id here is not accepted there.
**One system event comes back under `system_event`.** A listing puts its records under `data`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List system events
endpoints.summary: Lists the base system events, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of system events under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. System events are reference data and cannot be changed. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a system event
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one system event by its `evt_` id.

description.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

created_by.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

last_updated_by.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
